name: s3GetMetaData
syntax: s3GetMetaData(bucket, object [, accessKeyId, secretKey, host]) or s3GetMetaData(s3url [, accessKeyId, secretKey, host])
description: Returns the metadata for an S3 (or S3-compatible) object: content_type, content_length, etag, last_modified, storage_class and any x-amz-meta-* headers. Accepts either a bucket and object, or a single s3:// URL as the first argument.

params.name: bucket
params.description: The name of the S3 bucket, or a full s3:// URL.

params.name: object
params.description: The object key to inspect. Omitted when the first argument is an s3:// URL.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: Inline AWS access key id. Overrides credentials from Application.cfc and environment variables.

params.name: host
params.description: Inline endpoint URL for S3-compatible providers (e.g. Cloudflare R2, MinIO).

examples.title: Get object metadata by bucket and key
examples.description: Returns a struct with the object's metadata.

examples.title: Get object metadata from a URL
examples.description: Passing an s3:// URL as the first argument addresses the object directly.
